items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I went to play with Mabel E. Lane in a New Orleans jazz band. ... Oh, you know, Louis Kepert was playing on it.

ctx.x: Louis Kepert, Johnny, Johnny, uh, Sugar Johnny on trumpet. I had a rip home on trombone, Lions Dewey on clarinet, and, uh, Herbert Lindsay on violin.
